text.en: Pet owners consistently commend Ellie and her family for running a dependable and caring home-boarding and daycare service in Bush Hill. Reviewers describe a team that treats visiting dogs like family members, providing attentive supervision throughout each stay. Clients highlight their prompt responsiveness and willingness to assist when dogs require special medication or care.

Clients note that dogs of all temperaments, from active French bulldogs to gentle rescues, thrive in the structured daycare environment. Reviews describe happy dogs running enthusiastically into the house, enjoying ample outdoor garden space, and socialising with compatible playmates. Owners remark that shy dogs noticeably gain confidence and settle happily during longer boarding visits.

Owners traveling on holiday appreciate receiving regular photo and video updates through Instagram stories and messaging. Reviewers highlight that seeing their dogs playing outdoors and resting comfortably provides complete peace of mind while away. Clients also praise the team for keeping lines of communication open and answering questions swiftly.

q.en: Does Ellie's Doggy Adventure offer overnight dog boarding?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently use the service for overnight and week-long home boarding while away on holiday.

q.en: Can staff administer daily medication to boarding dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that Ellie and her team managed specific medication schedules and attentive care for dogs with health requirements.

q.en: How do pet owners receive updates during daycare or boarding?

a.en: Clients mention receiving regular photo and video updates through Instagram stories to see how their dogs are doing.

q.en: Does the daycare provide outdoor play space for dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviews describe ample outdoor garden space where dogs play safely under careful supervision.
